_readme: Curated global list of existing, planned, under-construction, stalled or cancelled desalination plants (Americas, Caribbean, Africa, Europe, Middle East, Asia, Pacific, Australia). Coordinates marked approx:true are the town/community, not the plant parcel. Every entry has a source URL. Updated 2026-11-07.
